tune.note: KNOWN GAP: raw tune verb gates on broadcast_receiver-flagged furniture; discovery is via the use/tv specializedAction panel, not the verb. NOTE tag/flag mismatch: use/tv gates on tag 'tv' but doUseTv queries the broadcast_receiver flag — a set with the flag but no 'tv' tag surfaces no examine action.
